title: Titan X Rainbow Burst Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: The Titan X Refill Kit in Rainbow Burst is designed for use with the Titan X Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. This practical refill pack includes a 2ml prefilled mouthpiece pod and three 5ml flavour-matched auto-refill capsules, offering easy, extended use with no messy refilling. Just click the pod and capsules into place on your Titan X device and you’re ready to go. Rainbow Burst captures the vibrant spirit of mixed-fruit confectionery flavours, blending a medley of sweet and tangy notes into a lively, satisfying vape. Bright and fruity with every puff, this dynamic flavour is balanced by a smooth nicotine salt formulation for a comfortable mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape and rapid nicotine relief. Designed with a pre-installed mesh coil for vivid flavour clarity and vapour production, the Titan X Refill Kit pairs perfectly with the Titan X device’s auto-refill technology, delivering up to approximately 10,000 puffs per refill cycle (usage-dependent).
